errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart, so the correct term for the bar with the largest value is "longest bar" (най-дългият стълб), not "highest bar" (най-високият стълб).

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени по низходящ ред на стойността на уязвимостта.
errors.evidence: The bars in the chart are visually arranged from top to bottom in ascending order of value (from 2,447 to 6,201), not descending order.

errors.text_span: Категориите на видовете заетост са представени по вертикалната ос, като са изброени в низходящ ред:
errors.evidence: This statement is ambiguous. While the text proceeds to list the categories in descending order of their values (from bottom to top of the chart), the chart itself presents the categories from top to bottom in ascending order of value. This creates confusion about the actual visual arrangement.
